decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'saves it with a title (auto-derived if you don't give one)' — only title auto-derived. R1 client: 'collect the page title, description, icon, and preview image automatically. I should be able to change the title and description both before and after saving.'
decisions.note: Prototype/spec-gate. Baseline only auto-derives title; client requests full metadata set (REF-BM-02) and pre/post edit (REF-BM-03) missing from presented scope.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Warns on duplicate addresses'. R1 client: 'Saving the same address again should not merely warn me; it should take me to the existing bookmark so I can edit it, without creating a duplicate.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Warn-only contradicts REF-BM-06's guide-to-edit convergence; client supplies the reference-conforming behaviour.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Edit titles and tags'. R1 client: 'I need to edit the address, title, description, tags, and a longer note.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Presented edit scope omits url/description/note; client extends to full REF-BM-04 field set.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: no note field present. R1 client: 'a longer note. Notes should support basic formatting and display that formatting when viewed.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Markdown/formatted note absent from baseline; client requests it (rendered formatting).

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'See all saved bookmarks' with no per-item fields. R1 client: 'The main list should show the title, description, tags, and page icon.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. List display fields (description, favicon) unspecified; client supplies REF-BM-07 readability set.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: browse feature does not mention opening originals. R1 client: 'selecting a bookmark should open the original page.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. REF-BM-08 navigation absent from presented scope; client requests it.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'search/filter by keyword across title, address, and tags'. R1 client: 'Search should ignore letter case and cover titles, descriptions, notes, and addresses. I also want tag searches such as #travel, exact phrases in quotation marks, and combinations using AND, OR, NOT, and parentheses.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Baseline search omits notes/description coverage, case-insensitivity, #tag syntax, phrases, and boolean/parens; client extends to the full REF-BM-12..16 search feature set (rule precision refined again in R2).

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: tag entry with no autocomplete. R1 client: 'When entering tags, I'd like suggestions from tags I have already used.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Tag autocomplete (REF-BM-10) absent; client requests it.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: no read-later concept. R1 client: 'I need a "read later" state, with a separate unread view and a way to mark items read.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Read-later state, unread view, mark-read all absent; client extends to REF-BM-17..19.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: only delete present. R1 client: 'I need archiving as well as deletion. Archived bookmarks should disappear from the normal list and search, appear in a separate archive view, and be restorable.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Archive (hide+restore+separate view, distinct from delete) absent; client extends to REF-BM-26..28.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: no bulk actions. R1 client: 'I want to select multiple bookmarks and change their tags, read status, archive status, or delete them together. I should also be able to apply those actions to everything matching my current search or filter.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Multi-select bulk (REF-BM-20) and apply-to-whole-filter (REF-BM-21) absent; client extends.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: no sort. R1 client: 'The list needs sorting, such as by date added or title.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Sort by key (REF-BM-22) absent; client requests it.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: no saved filters. R1 client: 'I want to save useful combinations of searches and included or excluded tags for reuse.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Bundles/saved searches (REF-BM-29) absent; client extends.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker assumption 5: 'No browser import/export in v1'. R1 client: 'I do want import and export using the usual browser bookmark file format, preserving titles, tags, and dates... assumption 5 needs changing.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Explicit exclusion contradicts REF-BM-30/31; client rejects the stated assumption and supplies conforming behaviour.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker assumption 4: 'Stores the reference + title only — does not archive full page contents'. R1 client: 'I want the app to preserve a local copy of a page, with PDFs saved as PDFs, and optionally save a copy through the Internet Archive... assumption 4 needs changing.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Explicit exclusion contradicts REF-BM-24/25 (snapshot + Internet Archive, PDF rule); client rejects assumption and supplies conforming behaviour.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Paste a web address; the app saves it'. R1 client accepts save-by-url without contest.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Presented save-by-url conforms to REF-BM-01.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'delete bookmarks (with a confirmation step)'. Client raised no objection.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Delete (REF-BM-05) present and conforming; confirmation is a functionally-equivalent addition.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'optional tags' / 'edit ... tags'. Client extended other areas but tags-assignment itself conforms.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Assign one/more tags (REF-BM-09) present and conforming.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'filter by tag'. Client did not contest.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Filter to a specific tag (REF-BM-11) present and conforming.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker default 1: 'New bookmarks default to unread'. R2 client: 'New bookmarks should not all become unread automatically. They should be ordinary bookmarks unless I choose "read later" while saving or mark them unread afterward.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. REF-BM-17's opt-in read-later model implies read-by-default; default-unread diverges and client supplies the conforming default.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker story 11: 'offline copy, PDFs as PDFs' (format of the copy unspecified). R2 client: 'A preserved web page should be stored as a self-contained HTML file. A PDF should remain a PDF.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Presentation left the snapshot format underspecified vs REF-BM-24's single self-contained HTML; client supplies the conforming format.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker story 8: bulk 'tags/read/archive/delete' (add vs replace unspecified). R2 client: 'Bulk tag changes need to let me explicitly add or remove tags without unintentionally replacing a bookmark's other tags.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Ambiguous bulk-tag semantics (could replace) diverge from REF-BM-20 add/remove; client supplies the delta semantics.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker story 4 lists 'AND/OR/NOT/parens' without stated rules. R2 client: 'a tag term and an ordinary text term together should both have to match, and the words AND, OR, or NOT should be treated as ordinary search text only when I put them in quotation marks.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Implicit-AND combination (REF-BM-14 edge rule) and the operators-literal-only-when-quoted rule (REF-BM-15) were not made explicit; client supplies the reference-conforming rules. Distinct aspect from R1 search-feature-existence.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker default 2: 'basic formatting = bold, italic, lists, links'. R2 client: 'The proposed basic note formatting ... [is] fine.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. WYSIWYG bold/italic/lists/links is a functionally-equivalent realisation of REF-BM-23 formatted+rendered notes; not a divergence. Client approval is bare acceptance of a conforming item.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker default 3: 'Standard browser bookmark format = Netscape bookmark HTML'. R2 client: 'the Netscape HTML import/export format [is] fine.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. Netscape HTML conforms exactly to REF-BM-30/31; bare approval of a conforming item.
